name: Ark UI
summary: Broad, active and provenance-signed headless components backed by Zag.js. The dialog spike passed with aria-modal=true and focus inside at 258.60 KB / 81.97 KB gzip, but 69 pinned @zag-js dependencies and about 44 MB installed are the cost.
losses: Smaller community than React Aria or Radix

spike.scenario: Dialog, React 19.2.0, plain CSS, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, labelledby and describedby present, focus inside the dialog.
